concepts.fiche:
Passé daté ou révolu (yesterday, in 2019, ago) → `prétérit`.
Lien avec le présent (for, since, already, yet, just) → `have + participe passé`.
**for** + durée, **since** + point de départ, durée + **ago** + prétérit.

Action en cours ou arrangement proche → `be + V-ing`.
Verbes d'état (know, believe, belong, want, own, seem) : jamais de forme en -ing.
Durée jusqu'à maintenant + activité → `have been + V-ing`.

Type 1 : `if + présent, will`. Type 2 : `if + prétérit, would`. Type 3 : `if + had + pp, would have + pp`.
Jamais **will** ni **would** dans la subordonnée en if de condition.
wish / if only + `prétérit` (présent irréel), + `had + pp` (regret).

Modal + base verbale, sans to ni s.
`should have + pp` : reproche. `must have + pp` : quasi-certitude. `can't have + pp` : quasi-impossibilité.
must (obligation) au passé → `had to`.

`be` (au temps voulu) + participe passé ; agent introduit par **by**.
Give, offer, tell, ask, show : la personne devient sujet → `He was given a prize.`
On impersonnel français → souvent un passif anglais.

Verbe introducteur au passé → recul : présent → prétérit, prétérit → past perfect, will → would.
Question indirecte : ordre sujet + verbe, sans do ; oui/non → **if / whether**.
Ordre : `tell / ask + COD + to + V`.

Enjoy, avoid, suggest, mind, keep, finish, risk, consider + `V-ing`. Préposition + `V-ing`.
Want, decide, refuse, manage, expect, hope + `to + V`.
look forward to, be used to, object to : **to** est une préposition → `V-ing`.

**who** : personne. **which** : chose. **that** : les deux, sauf après une virgule. **whose** : possession (dont).
Complément → le pronom peut disparaître : `the man I met`.
Préposition en fin de relative : `the house I live in`.

Généralité → article zéro : `Society is changing.` Cas précis → **the**.
Métier → **a / an** : `She is a lawyer.`
advice, news, information, evidence, progress, furniture : singulier, jamais de s ni de **a**.

Adjectif court : `-er than / the -est`. Long : `more … than / the most`.
De plus en plus : `more and more + adj long`, `-er and -er`.
Plus… plus : `the + comparatif, the + comparatif`.

Never, rarely, hardly, not only, no sooner, only then en tête → inversion auxiliaire / sujet.
Sans auxiliaire → do / does / did : `Rarely does he complain.`
`Hardly had… when`, `No sooner had… than`.

`make + COD + V` : contraindre. `let + COD + V` : laisser.
`have + COD + V` ou `get + COD + to + V` : faire faire par quelqu'un.
`have / get + chose + participe passé` : faire faire quelque chose.

exercices.enonce: They {{1}} the new tax in 2019. (introduce)
exercices.explication: In 2019 date l'action dans un passé révolu → prétérit.

exercices.enonce: She {{1}} in this firm since 2018. (work)
exercices.explication: Since + point de départ, situation toujours vraie → present perfect.

exercices.enonce: I {{1}} my keys two hours ago. (lose)
exercices.explication: Ago impose le prétérit.

exercices.enonce: We {{1}} the report yet. (not / finish)
exercices.explication: Yet en phrase négative → present perfect.

exercices.enonce: Inflation {{1}} a lot over the last three years. (rise)
exercices.explication: Over the last three years : période qui va jusqu'à maintenant → present perfect.

exercices.enonce: to write — present perfect, she
exercices.explication: Write, wrote, written.

exercices.enonce: I ___ him last week.
exercices.explication: Last week est révolu → prétérit.

exercices.enonce: It's the first time I ___ this mistake.
exercices.explication: It's the first time + present perfect.

exercices.enonce: She has lived here ___ ten years.
exercices.explication: Durée → for ; point de départ → since.

exercices.enonce: Le chômage a baissé en 2021.
exercices.explication: Passé daté → prétérit, malgré le passé composé français.

exercices.enonce: Be quiet, the minister {{1}}. (speak)
exercices.explication: Action en cours au moment où l'on parle → présent progressif.

exercices.enonce: This company {{1}} to a Chinese group. (belong)
exercices.explication: Belong est un verbe d'état : pas de forme progressive.

exercices.enonce: I {{1}} what you mean now. (understand)
exercices.explication: Understand est un verbe d'état.

exercices.enonce: He {{1}} English since he was six. (learn)
exercices.explication: Activité commencée et toujours en cours → present perfect progressif.

exercices.enonce: While the CEO {{1}}, the share price collapsed. (talk)
exercices.explication: Action de fond interrompue → prétérit progressif.

exercices.enonce: to run — prétérit progressif, they
exercices.explication: Was / were + V-ing.

exercices.enonce: I ___ you are right.
exercices.explication: Think au sens d'opinion est un verbe d'état.

exercices.enonce: They ___ a meeting at the moment.
exercices.explication: Have a meeting est une activité : le progressif est possible.

exercices.enonce: He ___ to live abroad.
exercices.explication: Want n'a pas de forme progressive.

exercices.enonce: Cette maison appartient à ma tante.
reponses: This house belongs to my aunt.
That house belongs to my aunt.
exercices.explication: Belong : verbe d'état, présent simple.

exercices.enonce: If it {{1}} tomorrow, the match will be cancelled. (rain)
exercices.explication: Type 1 : présent dans la subordonnée, jamais will.

exercices.enonce: If I {{1}} rich, I would travel more. (be)
exercices.explication: Type 2 : prétérit ; were est la forme soignée.

exercices.enonce: If he {{1}} harder, he would have passed. (work)
exercices.explication: Type 3 : past perfect dans la subordonnée.

exercices.enonce: If I had known, I {{1}} you. (call)
exercices.explication: Type 3 : would have + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: I wish I {{1}} more free time. (have)
exercices.explication: Wish + prétérit : regret sur le présent.

exercices.enonce: If only we {{1}} sooner! (leave / regret)
exercices.explication: If only + past perfect : regret sur le passé.

exercices.enonce: If I ___ you, I would apologise.
exercices.explication: Irréel du présent → prétérit, were à toutes les personnes.

exercices.enonce: I wish you ___ me earlier.
exercices.explication: Regret sur le passé → past perfect.

exercices.enonce: What would you do if you ___ your job?
exercices.explication: Pas de would après if.

exercices.enonce: Si j'avais su, je serais venu.
reponses: If I had known, I would have come.
Had I known, I would have come.
I would have come if I had known.
exercices.explication: Type 3, sans would dans la subordonnée.

exercices.enonce: You {{1}} told me before, now it's too late. (reproche)
exercices.explication: Reproche sur le passé → should have + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: The lights are off: they {{1}} left already. (quasi-certitude)
exercices.explication: Déduction sur le passé → must have + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: She {{1}} stolen the money, she was abroad. (quasi-impossibilité)
exercices.explication: Impossibilité déduite → can't have + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: Yesterday he {{1}} work late. (obligation)
exercices.explication: Must n'a pas de passé d'obligation → had to.

exercices.enonce: You {{1}} come if you don't want to. (absence d'obligation)
exercices.explication: Mustn't exprimerait l'interdiction.

exercices.enonce: He ___ speak three languages.
exercices.explication: Modal invariable, suivi de la base verbale.

exercices.enonce: You ___ smoke here, it's forbidden.
exercices.explication: Interdiction → mustn't.

exercices.enonce: They ___ missed the train, they are never late.
exercices.explication: Quasi-impossibilité passée → can't have.

exercices.enonce: She may ___ forgotten the appointment.
exercices.explication: Après un modal, la base verbale : have.

exercices.enonce: Tu aurais dû m'appeler.
reponses: You ought to have called me.
exercices.explication: Reproche → should have + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: The law {{1}} last month. (pass, passif)
exercices.explication: Passé daté, passif → was + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: The new stadium {{1}} next year. (build, passif, will)
exercices.explication: Modal + be + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: She {{1}} a better job last week. (offer, passif)
exercices.explication: Double complément : la personne devient sujet.

exercices.enonce: The road {{1}} at the moment. (repair, passif)
exercices.explication: Présent progressif passif → is being + pp.

exercices.enonce: Many mistakes {{1}} since 2020. (make, passif)
exercices.explication: Present perfect passif → have been + pp.

exercices.enonce: to choose — passif, prétérit, they
exercices.explication: Choose, chose, chosen.

exercices.enonce: He ___ a medal by the Queen.
exercices.explication: Passif avec la personne en sujet.

exercices.enonce: English ___ all over the world.
exercices.explication: Vérité générale au passif.

exercices.enonce: The decision was made ___ the board.
exercices.explication: L'agent du passif est introduit par by.

exercices.enonce: On m'a dit d'attendre.
exercices.explication: On impersonnel → passif, la personne en sujet.

exercices.enonce: He said he {{1}} tired. (be)
exercices.explication: I am tired → he said he was tired.

exercices.enonce: She told me she {{1}} the film before. (see)
exercices.explication: Prétérit ou present perfect → past perfect.

exercices.enonce: They promised they {{1}} us. (help)
exercices.explication: Will → would.

exercices.enonce: I asked him where he {{1}}. (live)
exercices.explication: Question indirecte : sujet + verbe, sans did.

exercices.enonce: The teacher told us {{1}} late. (not / be)
exercices.explication: Ordre négatif : not to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: She asked me ___ I was ready.
exercices.explication: Question fermée → if ou whether.

exercices.enonce: He ___ me that he was leaving.
exercices.explication: Tell + personne ; say n'a pas de COD de personne.

exercices.enonce: I wonder where ___.
exercices.explication: Question indirecte : pas d'inversion.

exercices.enonce: He ___ that he agreed.
exercices.explication: Say sans personne, tell avec une personne.

exercices.enonce: « I will call you tomorrow », he told her. (He told her…)
reponses: He told her he would call her the next day.
He told her that he would call her the next day.
He told her he would call her the following day.
He told her that he would call her the following day.
exercices.explication: Will → would, tomorrow → the next day.

exercices.enonce: He suggested {{1}} to the cinema. (go)
exercices.explication: Suggest + gérondif, jamais to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: She refused {{1}} the contract. (sign)
exercices.explication: Refuse + to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: I look forward to {{1}} you. (meet)
exercices.explication: To est ici une préposition → V-ing.

exercices.enonce: They avoided {{1}} about politics. (talk)
exercices.explication: Avoid + V-ing.

exercices.enonce: He left without {{1}} goodbye. (say)
exercices.explication: Préposition + V-ing.

exercices.enonce: We managed ___ on time.
exercices.explication: Manage + to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: I'm not used to ___ up so early.
exercices.explication: Be used to + V-ing : être habitué à.

exercices.enonce: Would you mind ___ the door?
exercices.explication: Mind + V-ing.

exercices.enonce: She stopped ___ ten years ago, and she feels better.
exercices.explication: Stop + V-ing : cesser de ; stop to + V : s'arrêter pour.

exercices.enonce: Elle a décidé de quitter son travail.
reponses: She decided to leave her job.
She decided to quit her job.
She has decided to leave her job.
She has decided to quit her job.
exercices.explication: Decide + to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: The woman {{1}} called you is my boss.
exercices.explication: Antécédent humain, sujet → who ou that.

exercices.enonce: He lives in a town, {{1}} is famous for its wine.
exercices.explication: Après une virgule, that est impossible → which.

exercices.enonce: The student {{1}} bag was stolen went to the police.
exercices.explication: Possession → whose, sans article derrière.

exercices.enonce: The company {{1}} she works for is Dutch.
exercices.explication: Antécédent non humain, complément de for.

exercices.enonce: What's the name of the author {{1}} novel won the prize?
exercices.explication: Dont exprimant la possession → whose + nom.

exercices.enonce: My sister, ___ lives in Rome, is a lawyer.
exercices.explication: Relative entre virgules, humain → who.

exercices.enonce: It's the film ___ we talked about.
exercices.explication: Antécédent non humain ; le pronom pourrait aussi disparaître.

exercices.enonce: He was late again, ___ annoyed everyone.
exercices.explication: Reprise de toute la proposition → which.

exercices.enonce: The man ___ car is parked here is my uncle.
exercices.explication: Possession → whose ; who's = who is.

exercices.enonce: L'homme que j'ai rencontré hier est médecin.
reponses: The man I met yesterday is a doctor.
The man who I met yesterday is a doctor.
The man that I met yesterday is a doctor.
The man whom I met yesterday is a doctor.
exercices.explication: Complément : le pronom relatif est facultatif. Métier avec article : a doctor.

exercices.enonce: My mother is {{1}} engineer.
exercices.explication: Métier → a / an, devant un son voyelle.

exercices.enonce: The news {{1}} bad this morning. (be)
exercices.explication: News est indénombrable singulier.

exercices.enonce: She gave me a {{1}} of advice.
exercices.explication: Advice est indénombrable → a piece of advice.

exercices.enonce: There isn't {{1}} evidence against him. (beaucoup)
exercices.explication: Indénombrable → much, pas many.

exercices.enonce: He went to {{1}} United States.
exercices.explication: Pays au pluriel → the.

exercices.enonce: ___ is the key to success.
exercices.explication: Notion générale → article zéro.

exercices.enonce: He has made great ___ this year.
exercices.explication: Progress est indénombrable.

exercices.enonce: ___ French drink less wine than before.
exercices.explication: Peuple entier, adjectif substantivé → the French.

exercices.enonce: I need some ___ about the course.
exercices.explication: Information est indénombrable.

exercices.enonce: La société change.
exercices.explication: Notion générale → article zéro.

exercices.enonce: London is {{1}} than Paris. (big)
exercices.explication: Adjectif court : -er, consonne doublée.

exercices.enonce: This exercise is {{1}} than the last one. (difficult)
exercices.explication: Adjectif long → more.

exercices.enonce: It's the {{1}} film I've ever seen. (bad)
exercices.explication: Bad, worse, the worst.

exercices.enonce: The more you read, {{1}} you write. (well)
exercices.explication: The + comparatif des deux côtés ; well → better.

exercices.enonce: It is getting {{1}} to find a flat. (hard, de plus en plus)
exercices.explication: Adjectif court → -er and -er.

exercices.enonce: far — comparatif
exercices.explication: Far, farther / further.

exercices.enonce: She works ___ than her brother.
exercices.explication: Hard, adverbe court → harder.

exercices.enonce: He is not as tall ___ his father.
exercices.explication: Not as… as.

exercices.enonce: Life is becoming ___ expensive.
exercices.explication: De plus en plus + adjectif long → more and more.

exercices.enonce: Plus on est riche, plus on dépense.
reponses: The richer you are, the more you spend.
The richer people are, the more they spend.
The richer we are, the more we spend.
The richer one is, the more one spends.
exercices.explication: The + comparatif, the + comparatif.

exercices.enonce: Never {{1}} such a mess. (I / see, present perfect)
exercices.explication: Never en tête → auxiliaire avant le sujet.

exercices.enonce: Rarely {{1}} about his past. (he / talk, présent)
exercices.explication: Pas d'auxiliaire → does + sujet + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: Not only {{1}} late, but he also forgot the report. (he / be, prétérit)
exercices.explication: Be s'inverse directement.

exercices.enonce: No sooner {{1}} than the phone rang. (she / arrive)
exercices.explication: No sooner had + sujet + pp … than.

exercices.enonce: Only then {{1}} the truth. (we / understand, prétérit)
exercices.explication: Only then en tête → did + sujet + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: Under no circumstances ___ this door.
exercices.explication: Expression négative en tête → inversion.

exercices.enonce: Little ___ what was about to happen.
exercices.explication: Little en tête → did + sujet + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: Hardly had I sat down ___ the meeting started.
exercices.explication: Hardly… when ; no sooner… than.

exercices.enonce: Not until 1944 ___ women vote in France.
exercices.explication: Not until en tête → inversion dans la principale.

exercices.enonce: « I have never read such a good novel. » (Never…)
reponses: Never have I read such a good novel.
exercices.explication: Adverbe négatif en tête → inversion.

exercices.enonce: The film made me {{1}}. (cry)
exercices.explication: Make + COD + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: I must have my car {{1}}. (repair)
exercices.explication: Have + chose + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: She got her brother {{1}} her. (help)
exercices.explication: Get + personne + to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: They let us {{1}} early. (leave)
exercices.explication: Let + COD + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: He had his hair {{1}} yesterday. (cut)
exercices.explication: Have + chose + participe passé ; cut, cut, cut.

exercices.enonce: My parents made me ___ the piano.
exercices.explication: Make actif + base verbale sans to.

exercices.enonce: He was made ___ the truth.
exercices.explication: Make au passif + to + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: We are having our house ___.
exercices.explication: Have + chose + participe passé.

exercices.enonce: I'll get him ___ the document.
exercices.explication: Get + personne + to ; have + personne + base verbale.

exercices.enonce: Elle a fait réparer sa voiture.
reponses: She has had her car repaired.
exercices.explication: Have / get + chose + participe passé.
